title: 古里水壩~Guri Dam
focus: 大型法蘭西斯轉輪更新與證據鏈~Large Francis runner renewal and evidence chains
summary: 古里案例以供應商公開的機組更新紀錄為起點，研究汽蝕、效率試驗、轉矩與對心、冷卻及停機順序。課程要求每項改善主張都有對應量測與比較工況，並把轉輪最大出力、名目出力和全廠供電可靠度分開。學員以故障假說表統整水力與機械證據。~Starting from a supplier record of Guri modernization, study cavitation, efficiency testing, torque, alignment, cooling and outage sequence. Each claimed improvement requires matching measurements and comparable operating conditions. Runner maximum power, nominal output and plant supply reliability remain separate concepts, brought together through a table of hydraulic and mechanical fault hypotheses.
history: 供應商紀錄描述古里第二發電廠五部機組更新，並記載二〇一二年安裝大型法蘭西斯轉輪。文中的七百七十兆瓦是轉輪相關最大功率尺度，不能當作全廠裝機容量，也不能與名目功率混用。本課據此研究設備更新如何驗證，不推定未讀得的壩體施工年代或當前所有設備狀態。歷史監測手冊只是比較文獻，原創測試輸入及二〇二六年覆核日期另列，避免把教材算式寫成供應商保證。~The supplier account describes modernization of five units in Guri powerhouse No. 2 and installation of a large Francis runner in 2012. Its 770 MW figure concerns maximum runner-related power, not total plant capacity or nominal output. The course uses this evidence to examine verification of renewal without inferring unread dam-construction dates or present condition of every unit. Instrumentation literature supplies bibliographic context; original test inputs and the 2026 review date are separate from any supplier performance guarantee.
example: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「效率試驗不確定度」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「汽蝕可用水頭」及「低速巨型轉矩」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981；第二組為 Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。~This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Efficiency test uncertainty, then compare the controlling variables in Available cavitation head and Large torque at low speed. The first calculation is uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981; the second is Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.

units.anchor: 效率試驗不確定度~Efficiency test uncertainty
units.title: 效率試驗不確定度~Efficiency test uncertainty
units.mechanism: 更新驗收先定義電端輸出與水力輸入的量測邊界，再討論效率差是否大於量測不確定度。流量、水頭與功率誤差會共同傳到效率；獨立小誤差可用平方和開根近似，但共用校準或同一基準造成的相關誤差必須保留協方差，不能假裝會互相抵消。 標準不確定度與擴充不確定度不能直接相混，若資料給涵蓋因子，應先換成同一層級再進行傳播。~Renewal acceptance first defines electrical-output and hydraulic-input boundaries, then asks whether an efficiency change exceeds measurement uncertainty. Flow, head and power errors all propagate into efficiency. Independent small errors permit a root-sum-square approximation, while shared calibration or reference errors require covariance and cannot be assumed to cancel. Standard and expanded uncertainties cannot be mixed directly; when a coverage factor is supplied, convert every input to the same uncertainty level before propagation.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981。模型邊界：各輸入為無因次相對標準不確定度，互相獨立且誤差小；不是擴充信賴區間。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981. Model boundary: dimensionless relative standard uncertainties, mutually independent and small; not an expanded confidence interval.
units.verify: 查閱各儀表校準的標準不確定度及共同來源，將不同工況的重複試驗分開統計。若改善幅度與不確定度相近，應報告分辨能力不足，再研究增加樣本能否降低隨機項，而非期待它消除系統偏差。~Review standard calibration uncertainties and shared causes, keeping repeated tests at different operating points separate. If the claimed improvement is comparable to uncertainty, report limited resolution and assess whether more samples reduce random components rather than expecting them to remove systematic bias.
units.failure: 水頭與流量共用錯誤時間窗會造成相關偏差，直接平方和會低估或高估結果；更新前後若換了儀表量程，也可能製造看似效率改善的校準差。~Head and discharge using the same incorrect time window can have correlated errors, invalidating a simple sum of squares. Changing instrument ranges between tests may also create an apparent efficiency improvement that is actually a calibration difference.
units.misconception: 重複測試足夠多次就能消除所有偏差~Enough repeated tests eliminate every systematic measurement bias.
units.practice: 為三個量測項建立不確定度表，再加入流量與水頭正相關情境，重算效率不確定度，指出改善哪一項儀表最能提高辨識能力。~Build an uncertainty budget for the three measurements, add positive correlation between head and flow, and recompute efficiency uncertainty. Identify the instrument improvement that most increases the ability to resolve a performance change.

units.anchor: 汽蝕可用水頭~Available cavitation head
units.title: 汽蝕可用水頭~Available cavitation head
units.mechanism: 法蘭西斯轉輪低壓區受尾水淹沒、當地大氣壓與水溫蒸氣壓共同影響，不能只由水庫水位判定汽蝕條件。教材把壓力全部換成水頭，再用機組淨水頭標準化，取得可用汽蝕係數。所需係數依轉輪與工況改變，必須另由試驗或經驗資料取得。 轉輪基準高於尾水時吸出高度為正，淹沒時則可能為負，符號定義會直接改變可用水頭帳。~Low pressure around a Francis runner depends on tailwater submergence, atmospheric pressure and temperature-dependent vapor pressure, not reservoir level alone. Convert pressures to head and normalize by net machine head to obtain an available cavitation coefficient. The required coefficient varies with runner and operating point and needs separate test evidence. Runner setting above tailwater is positive under this convention, while submergence can be negative; that sign definition directly changes the available-head account.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12。模型邊界：Hs為轉輪基準高於尾水的正值；只算假想可用係數，未提供所需係數。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12. Model boundary: Hs is positive when the runner reference is above tailwater; hypothetical available coefficient only, with no required coefficient supplied.
units.verify: 同步量測尾水高程、大氣壓與水溫，核對轉輪基準點定義，再將壓力脈動及表面檢查與運轉工況配對。若水溫上升時問題加重，應檢查蒸氣壓變化，而不只調整淹沒深度假設。~Measure tailwater elevation, atmospheric pressure and water temperature together, checking the runner reference definition. Pair pressure pulsation and surface inspection with operating condition. Deterioration at warmer water calls for investigating vapor-pressure changes rather than modifying only the assumed submergence depth.
units.failure: 高海拔較低大氣壓會減少可用壓力餘量，溫水又提高蒸氣壓；若誤用海平面常數及固定水溫，可能在相同淨水頭下錯判汽蝕條件。~Lower atmospheric pressure reduces available margin, and warmer water raises vapor pressure. Using sea-level pressure and a fixed temperature can therefore misrepresent cavitation conditions even when the net generating head remains unchanged during comparison.
units.misconception: 相同淨水頭必定具有相同汽蝕餘量~Equal net head always provides equal cavitation margin.
units.practice: 固定機組淨水頭，分別降低大氣壓水頭與提高蒸氣壓水頭，重算可用係數，並說明還缺哪張試驗曲線才能比較所需餘量。~At fixed net head, lower atmospheric head and raise vapor-pressure head separately. Recalculate the available coefficient and identify the test curve still required to compare it with the necessary margin.

units.anchor: 低速巨型轉矩~Large torque at low speed
units.title: 低速巨型轉矩~Large torque at low speed
units.mechanism: 大型水輪機在低轉速傳遞高功率時，軸系轉矩可非常大，因此功率相同不代表機械尺寸相同。利用功率除以角速度取得平均轉矩，先釐清每分鐘轉數與弧度每秒的換算。軸徑、鍵接與法蘭還受彎矩、疲勞及動態扭振控制，不能只由平均值定尺寸。 平均扭矩對應平均軸功率，電氣輸出還需透過發電機損失換算，兩個邊界不得未經說明直接混合。~A large hydro turbine transmitting high power at low speed develops substantial shaft torque, so equal power does not imply equal mechanical dimensions. Divide power by angular speed to obtain mean torque, converting revolutions per minute correctly. Shaft, coupling and flange design also depends on bending, fatigue and torsional dynamics. Mean torque corresponds to shaft power; electrical output requires conversion through generator losses, and the two measurement boundaries cannot be silently interchanged in the calculation.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P=600 MW; n=100 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=P*1e6/omega/1e6=57.29577951 MN*m。模型邊界：恆速平均機械功率，不含電效率換算及動態扭矩峰值。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P=600 MW; n=100 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=P*1e6/omega/1e6=57.29577951 MN*m. Model boundary: constant-speed mean mechanical power, excluding electrical efficiency conversion and dynamic torque peaks.
units.verify: 對齊機械功率估計、軸速與扭振量測，確認電端功率是否已換算到軸端。用不同負載下的平均轉矩趨勢檢查模型，若振動峰值增加而平均值正常，應研究動態扭振而非只增加靜態安全係數。~Align shaft-power estimates, speed and torsional measurements, checking conversion from terminal electrical power. Compare mean torque over several loads. Increasing oscillatory peaks with a normal mean calls for dynamic investigation rather than simply raising a static factor in the calculation.
units.failure: 把每分鐘轉數直接當角速度會造成嚴重單位錯誤，並低估低速傳動需求；負載拒絕時轉速與轉矩同時變動，穩態公式也不能描述整個暫態。~Using revolutions per minute directly as angular speed creates a major unit error and misrepresents low-speed transmission demand. Speed and torque change together during load rejection, which a constant-speed mean calculation cannot describe over the complete transient.
units.misconception: 相同功率的所有機組都具有相同轉矩~All machines delivering equal power necessarily have equal torque.
units.practice: 在功率不變下比較兩種轉速的轉矩，畫出反比例曲線，再指出軸系強度評估仍需的彎矩、疲勞循環與接頭幾何資料。~Compare torque at two speeds while holding power constant and plot the inverse relationship. Identify bending, fatigue-cycle and connection-geometry data still needed to assess the shaft system.

units.anchor: 轉子不平衡力~Rotor unbalance force
units.title: 轉子不平衡力~Rotor unbalance force
units.mechanism: 轉子不平衡量可用質量乘偏心距表示，旋轉時產生隨角速度平方增加的週期力。平衡修正需知道相位與支承反應，而不是只測振幅。教材估算激振力尺度後，要求區分軸彎曲、對心偏差與水力不對稱，因它們也可能在轉頻附近產生訊號。 不平衡力是隨軸旋轉的向量，固定方向感測器看到其投影，量測相位可提供配重位置而振幅單獨不能。~Rotor unbalance is expressed as mass times eccentricity and generates a periodic force proportional to angular speed squared. Correction requires phase and support response, not amplitude alone. After estimating excitation scale, distinguish bent shafts, misalignment and hydraulic asymmetry, which can also produce signals near rotational frequency. Unbalance force rotates as a vector; a fixed sensor observes its projection, making phase information essential for locating a correction mass rather than amplitude alone.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：U=500 kg*m; n=100 rpm; F=U*(2*pi*n/60)**2=54831.13556 N。模型邊界：剛性轉子單一不平衡量的力幅，未含支承傳遞與共振放大。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: U=500 kg*m; n=100 rpm; F=U*(2*pi*n/60)**2=54831.13556 N. Model boundary: force amplitude from one rigid-rotor unbalance, without support transmission or resonant amplification.
units.verify: 同步量測鍵相信號與軸承兩方向振動，比較空轉及帶水負載的相位穩定性。若相位隨水頭大幅改變，應檢查水力激振；若試重後反應不符線性比例，需研究支承非線性或轉子柔性。~Measure phase reference and two bearing-vibration directions, comparing unloaded and hydraulic-load phase stability. Strong head-dependent phase changes suggest hydraulic excitation. A trial-weight response inconsistent with linear proportionality calls for investigating support nonlinearity or rotor flexibility before applying a simple balance correction.
units.failure: 將所有轉頻振動都當成不平衡，可能加上錯誤配重而增加軸承負荷；感測器方向或相位基準反轉也會把修正位置推到錯誤角度，必須先確認座標。~Treating every rotational-frequency vibration as unbalance can lead to an incorrect correction mass and greater bearing load. Reversed sensor orientation or phase reference can also place a correction at the wrong angle, making coordinate verification essential.
units.misconception: 出現轉頻振動就一定是轉子不平衡~A vibration at rotational frequency always proves rotor unbalance.
units.practice: 將轉速提高一成，重算不平衡力並與線性增加的錯誤預測比較，再列出平衡試驗必須保存的相位、方向及試重位置。~Increase speed by ten percent, recompute unbalance force and compare it with an incorrect linear prediction. List the phase, direction and trial-weight positions that a balance experiment must preserve.

units.anchor: 熱態軸線對心~Thermal operating alignment
units.title: 熱態軸線對心~Thermal operating alignment
units.mechanism: 冷態安裝時的軸線對心不一定等於運轉熱態對心，支承座與基礎的溫升差可能改變相對位置。教材以一支承構件的自由熱伸長估算偏移來源，再要求把方向與約束列明。實際軸承中心移動需同時考慮連接件與溫度場，不能只量外殼表面。 相對對心取決於兩支承位移之差，共同熱膨脹可能不改變相對偏移，卻仍影響管路或外部連接。~Cold installation alignment need not equal hot operating alignment because support and foundation temperature changes can shift relative positions. Free expansion of one support illustrates a possible offset, with direction and restraint stated explicitly. Actual bearing-center movement also depends on connections and temperature distribution rather than one external surface temperature. Relative alignment depends on the difference between support movements; common expansion may leave alignment unchanged while still affecting piping or other external connections.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：alpha=0.000012 1/K; L=1.8 m; dT=30 K; dL=alpha*L*dT*1000=0.648 mm。模型邊界：均溫自由伸長沿支承長度方向，非整個軸系實際偏移。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: alpha=0.000012 1/K; L=1.8 m; dT=30 K; dL=alpha*L*dT*1000=0.648 mm. Model boundary: uniform free extension along one support length, not the actual displacement of the entire shaft line.
units.verify: 量測支承內外溫度及軸承中心熱態位置，與冷態基線使用同一座標系比較。若偏移隨負載穩定重現，支持熱變形解釋；若卸載後不回復，應查接合滑移、墊片或基礎沉陷。~Measure internal and external support temperatures and the hot bearing-center position on the same coordinate system as the cold baseline. Repeatable load-dependent movement supports thermal deformation. Movement that remains after cooling requires investigation of connection slip, shims or foundation settlement.
units.failure: 只以冷態對心合格作結論，可能漏掉運轉中接頭偏角與軸承附加力；但熱態量測基座若同時伸長，也會混入儀器效應，應設獨立基準。~Accepting cold alignment alone can overlook operating coupling angles and additional bearing force. A measurement mounting that expands simultaneously can also contaminate the apparent movement, requiring an independent reference before attributing the entire offset to the machine.
units.misconception: 冷態對心合格就保證熱態對心不變~Acceptable cold alignment guarantees unchanged alignment during hot operation.
units.practice: 比較兩個不同長度及溫升的支承自由伸長，求相對偏移，再畫出受約束時可能不同的變形方向，提出熱態對心所需測點。~Compare free expansion of two supports with different lengths and temperature rises, calculate relative offset, and draw how restraint could change movement directions. Propose measurement points for hot alignment verification.

units.anchor: 局部熱阻與熱點~Local thermal resistance and hotspots
units.title: 局部熱阻與熱點~Local thermal resistance and hotspots
units.mechanism: 電機繞組或軸承熱點由熱源與散熱路徑共同控制，總冷卻流量正常不代表局部熱阻正常。等效熱阻乘熱流可估算兩節點溫差，但接觸、導熱與對流應按實際路徑串並聯。教材把單一路徑作基準，再要求辨認旁路及熱容量造成的暫態。 串聯熱阻相加而並聯導熱能力相加，選錯連接方式會錯判熱流方向及熱點，應先畫熱路圖。~A winding or bearing hotspot depends on heat generation and its removal path, so normal total cooling flow does not establish normal local thermal resistance. Heat flow times equivalent resistance estimates a two-node temperature difference. Contact, conduction and convection must be connected according to the real path, including bypasses and thermal storage. Series thermal resistances add, while parallel conductances add; choosing the wrong connection misrepresents heat paths and hotspots, so draw the thermal network first.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qheat=400000 W; Rth=0.00008 K/W; dT=Qheat*Rth=32 K。模型邊界：穩態單一等效熱阻，熱流全部通過該路徑。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qheat=400000 W; Rth=0.00008 K/W; dT=Qheat*Rth=32 K. Model boundary: steady single equivalent thermal resistance with all stated heat following that path.
units.verify: 在熱源附近與冷卻端同時量溫，透過不同負載下的溫差斜率估算熱阻，再比較停機冷卻曲線。若穩態溫差增大但熱源功率未變，應研究接觸劣化或結垢；若只有時間常數改變，需另查熱容量與流量分配。~Measure temperatures near the source and cooling end, infer resistance from temperature difference over several loads, and compare cooldown curves. A larger steady difference at unchanged heat load suggests contact degradation or fouling, while changed response time also requires considering thermal capacity and flow distribution.
units.failure: 接觸面鬆動會增加熱阻並形成局部高溫，平均出口水溫可能仍正常；若感測器離熱點太遠，訊號會被導熱平滑，延後發現絕緣或潤滑問題。~A loose contact increases thermal resistance and local temperature while average outlet water can remain normal. A sensor far from the hotspot smooths the signal through conduction and can delay recognition of insulation or lubrication deterioration.
units.misconception: 總冷卻流量正常就代表局部熱阻正常~Normal total cooling flow proves that local thermal resistance is normal.
units.practice: 把等效熱阻增加一半並保持熱負荷，計算新溫差，再建立兩條並聯散熱路徑，說明新增旁路如何改變局部熱流而非只改變總流量。~Increase resistance by half at fixed heat load and calculate the new temperature difference. Then build two parallel heat paths and explain how a bypass changes local heat flow rather than only total coolant flow.

units.anchor: 疲勞循環累積~Fatigue cycle accumulation
units.title: 疲勞循環累積~Fatigue cycle accumulation
units.mechanism: 轉輪與軸系承受的交變荷載需要按幅值及循環次數整理，平均功率相同可能具有不同疲勞歷程。線性損傷和可作教材尺度分析，但材料曲線、平均應力與荷載先後次序會影響真實壽命。計算值不能直接當成剩餘年限，尤其缺少裂紋狀態時。 每一組疲勞壽命必須對應同一應力幅定義，範圍與振幅差一倍，混用會嚴重改變材料曲線取值。~Alternating runner and shaft loads require cycle counts by amplitude; equal mean power can hide different fatigue histories. A linear damage sum provides a teaching scale, while material curves, mean stress and sequence affect actual life. The calculated fraction cannot directly be converted into remaining years, particularly without crack-state information. Every fatigue life must use the same stress definition; stress range and amplitude differ by a factor of two, strongly affecting the selected material-curve value.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：n1=200000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=1000000 cycles; N2=5000000 cycles; D=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.4。模型邊界：假設已給定兩級疲勞壽命與線性累積，非現場壽命保證。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: n1=200000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=1000000 cycles; N2=5000000 cycles; D=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.4. Model boundary: two assumed fatigue lives and linear accumulation, not a field life guarantee.
units.verify: 對應變時序進行循環計數，核對高低幅值分類與材料試驗的應力定義一致。再以非破壞檢查追蹤裂紋或缺陷；若累積指標低而裂紋成長，應查局部集中及模型遺漏，而不是否定檢查結果。~Count cycles from strain histories and ensure amplitude definitions match the material test data. Track cracks or defects with nondestructive inspection. Crack growth despite a low damage index calls for investigating local concentration and omitted mechanisms rather than dismissing the inspection evidence.
units.failure: 少量高幅值事件可能主導疲勞，低頻平均紀錄會把它們抹平；若將不同應力集中位置混成一張循環表，也會使線性損傷值失去物理意義。~A few high-amplitude events can dominate fatigue and disappear in low-frequency averages. Combining histories from different stress-concentration locations into one cycle table can also remove the physical meaning of a nominal linear damage sum.
units.misconception: 相同平均功率就保證相同疲勞壽命~Equal mean power guarantees equal fatigue life.
units.practice: 保持總循環數，將一部分低幅循環改為高幅循環，重算損傷和，再列出平均應力與腐蝕環境會如何限制這個簡化比較。~Keep total cycle count fixed while replacing some low-amplitude cycles with high-amplitude cycles. Recalculate the damage sum and explain how mean stress and corrosion constrain the simplified comparison.

units.anchor: 表面磨耗質量~Surface wear mass loss
units.title: 表面磨耗質量~Surface wear mass loss
units.mechanism: 轉輪表面損失的體積可由面積與平均厚度變化估算，再用材料密度換成質量，但磨耗通常高度不均勻。局部坑蝕深度對應力集中及水力形狀的影響，可能比總失重更重要。量測必須追蹤同一坐標區域，修補材料也需從原材損失中分開。 平均厚度須按面積加權，不能把不同大小區塊的厚度直接算術平均，否則質量帳會與表面幾何不一致。~Surface loss can be estimated from area and mean thickness change and converted to mass with density, but wear is rarely uniform. Local pit depth may matter more than total mass for stress concentration and hydraulic shape. Repeat measurements must track the same coordinates and distinguish repair material from original material loss. Mean thickness requires area weighting; a simple mean of unequal patch sizes gives a mass account inconsistent with the measured surface geometry and affected area.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：A=12 m2; dt=0.0008 m; rho=7800 kg/m3; dm=A*dt*rho=74.88 kg。模型邊界：平均均勻厚度損失的體積近似，未描述局部坑蝕。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: A=12 m2; dt=0.0008 m; rho=7800 kg/m3; dm=A*dt*rho=74.88 kg. Model boundary: volume approximation for mean uniform thickness loss, without describing local pitting.
units.verify: 將三維掃描對準固定控制點，建立厚度損失分布而不只報平均值，並用已知厚度區域檢查掃描偏差。對最大坑深另作局部檢查，若總失重很小但形狀尖銳，仍需評估應力與流場。~Register three-dimensional scans to fixed controls and map thickness loss rather than reporting only its mean. Check scan bias against known-thickness regions and inspect maximum pit depth separately. Small total mass loss with sharp local geometry still requires stress and flow assessment.
units.failure: 掃描對位誤差可在整片表面製造假磨耗，修補塗層又可能掩蓋下方缺陷；如果只以總重量驗收，會漏掉局部形狀造成的水力性能及疲勞問題。~Registration error can create apparent wear over a large surface, while a repair layer can conceal underlying defects. Acceptance based only on total weight can miss local geometry effects on hydraulic performance and fatigue behavior.
units.misconception: 總失重量小就表示局部磨耗無害~Small total mass loss proves that local wear is harmless.
units.practice: 設計兩個失重量相同但坑深分布不同的表面，計算平均厚度並比較最大深度，再提出哪些掃描解析度與檢查方法能區分其風險。~Construct two surfaces with equal mass loss but different pit-depth distributions. Calculate mean thickness and compare maximum depth, then choose scan resolution and inspection methods that distinguish their implications.

units.anchor: 檢測陽性與基率~Inspection positives and base rates
units.title: 檢測陽性與基率~Inspection positives and base rates
units.mechanism: 非破壞檢測的陽性訊號不等於缺陷已被確認，解讀還需要靈敏度、特異度與受檢群的缺陷基率。貝氏帳可把真陽性與假陽性分開，說明低基率時為何需要第二種方法確認。教材機率均為假設，不代表任何現場檢測程序的認證能力。 陽性預測值回答已出現訊號後的缺陷機率，靈敏度回答已知有缺陷時能否檢出，兩者條件方向相反。~A positive nondestructive indication is not a confirmed defect; interpretation also requires sensitivity, specificity and defect prevalence in the inspected population. A Bayesian account separates true and false positives and explains the value of a second confirmation method at low prevalence. Teaching probabilities do not certify any actual inspection procedure. Positive predictive value asks about a defect after an indication, while sensitivity asks about detection given a defect; the conditioning direction is different in these questions.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：prev=0.02 (dimensionless); sens=0.90 (dimensionless); spec=0.95 (dimensionless); PPV=prev*sens/(prev*sens+(1-prev)*(1-spec))=0.2686567164。模型邊界：無因次機率且適用同一受檢群，假設靈敏度與特異度已知。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: prev=0.02 (dimensionless); sens=0.90 (dimensionless); spec=0.95 (dimensionless); PPV=prev*sens/(prev*sens+(1-prev)*(1-spec))=0.2686567164. Model boundary: dimensionless probabilities for the same inspected population, with sensitivity and specificity assumed known.
units.verify: 用已知缺陷試件與盲測樣本估計混淆矩陣，區分操作者、材料厚度與表面條件。將陽性部位交由不同物理原理複核，並記錄未檢出案例；若只保留陽性樣本，就無法可靠估計漏失率及基率。~Estimate a confusion matrix using known-defect specimens and blind samples, separating operator, thickness and surface conditions. Confirm indications with another physical principle and retain missed-defect cases. Keeping only positive samples prevents reliable estimation of prevalence and the missed-detection rate.
units.failure: 將靈敏度直接當成陽性可信度會高估低基率群的確診比例；第二次檢查若使用同樣缺陷敏感性與共同誤差，也不能當成完全獨立的確認。~Treating sensitivity as positive predictive value overstates confirmed defects in a low-prevalence population. A second inspection sharing the same blind spots and error sources cannot automatically be counted as independent confirmation of the first indication.
units.misconception: 檢測靈敏度就是陽性結果的確診機率~Inspection sensitivity equals the probability that a positive result is a true defect.
units.practice: 以一萬個假想檢查位置建立真陽性與假陽性人數表，將基率提高後重算，解釋檢查能力不變時陽性可信度為何仍會改變。~Build true-positive and false-positive counts for ten thousand hypothetical inspection locations. Increase prevalence and recalculate, explaining why predictive value changes even though the inspection sensitivity and specificity remain unchanged.

units.anchor: 更新停機能量機會~Renewal outage energy opportunity
units.title: 更新停機能量機會~Renewal outage energy opportunity
units.mechanism: 機組更新需要停機窗口，其機會成本取決於原本可發功率與水量能否由其他機組利用。以假定功率乘停機時數得到的是潛在電量差，不是必然實際損失。若水可留待稍後使用或轉移到其他機組，仍需建立跨時段水量及效率帳才能比較更新方案。 被延後發出的電量與永遠旁通的能量必須分別記帳，時間價值可能不同，但不能因此混淆物理能量損失。~Renewal requires outage windows whose opportunity cost depends on counterfactual output and whether other units can use the water. Assumed power times outage duration gives potential energy difference, not inevitable loss. Storage for later use or transfer to other machines requires a multi-interval water and efficiency account before comparing renewal plans. Energy generated later and energy permanently bypassed require separate accounts; their time value may differ without making both quantities the same physical energy loss.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pcounter=300 MW; tout=18 h; Epotential=Pcounter*tout=5400 MWh。模型邊界：假設原本能持續發電且無替代利用，只算反事實電量上界情境。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pcounter=300 MW; tout=18 h; Epotential=Pcounter*tout=5400 MWh. Model boundary: assumes continuous counterfactual generation and no substitute water use; an upper scenario for displaced energy.
units.verify: 將檢修時程與逐時來水、其他機組餘裕及水庫可用空間配對，核對實際旁通水量。若停機期間水被儲存，需追蹤後續發電而不能在停機當日把全部潛在電量列為永久損失。~Pair the outage schedule with hourly inflow, spare unit capacity and available storage, checking actual bypassed water. If water is retained during the outage, follow its later generation rather than booking the entire potential energy difference as a permanent loss on that day.
units.failure: 檢修延誤若跨入高流量期間，原可儲存的水可能轉為旁通，損失機制因而改變；只用全年平均功率估算，會漏掉停機時序與其他設備限制的關聯。~An outage delay into a high-flow period can turn storable water into bypassed release and change the loss mechanism. Annual mean power misses the relationship among outage timing, hydrology and restrictions on the other equipment.
units.misconception: 停機時數乘額定功率就是必然損失電量~Outage hours times rated power always equal unavoidable lost generation.
units.practice: 比較立即更新與延後更新兩個時程，設定可儲存水量及替代機組容量，分別計算潛在與實際未利用電量，列出決策仍需的可靠度資料。~Compare immediate and delayed renewal schedules with stated storage space and substitute-unit capacity. Calculate potential and actually unused energy separately, then identify reliability information still needed for the decision.
